scripts.build: bun run tsc --noEmit && echo 'Type check passed ✅'
scripts.test:skip-continue: bun run test:check && bun test tests/e2e/skip-phase-continue-e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:skip-quit: bun run test:check && bun test tests/e2e/skip-phase-quit-e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:skip: bun run test:skip-continue && bun run test:skip-quit
scripts.pre-test: bun run test:check && bun run pre-test:cleanup
scripts.pre-test:check-dir: test -f package.json || (echo '❌ Error: Must run from project root' && exit 1)
scripts.pre-test:cleanup: rm -rf tests/test-area && mkdir -p tests/test-area && echo '✅ Test area cleaned and recreated'
